notes.title: Heroes of Time: New Update Adds Korean, Turkish, and Arabic Languages
notes.notes:
Heroes of Time has just received a new update that adds support for Korean, Turkish, and Arabic languages. This update is a result of the feedback we received from our community. We are thrilled to make the game more accessible to players who speak these languages.

In addition to this update, we are excited to announce that a new game is coming soon as an add-on to Heroes of Time. The new game will take place in the same world and time period as Heroes of Time, but with a different protagonist. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new adventure in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Game Update - Enhanced Experience!
notes.notes: We've taken your feedback to heart and made significant enhancements. Say goodbye to pesky typos with massive spelling corrections across all languages. Achievements are now bug-free. Plus, get ready for a fresh look with our new official logo before the game. This is just the beginning - stay tuned for exciting updates to come!

notes.title: Unravel the Expanded Saga: Ettrian - The Elf Prince Enhanced Update!
Master Update: Bug Fixes and New Languages Added
notes.notes: We've listened to your feedback and fixed several bugs that were hindering your enjoyment of the game. Additionally, we've added Italian, French, German, and Spanish to the list of supported languages, making it easier for non-English speakers to fully immerse themselves in the game.
